date_note: The articles give only their publication day, 24 November, for the DGAC's notice to users; they say the attack took place from 5 to 9 November 2026.
title: France's DGAC says its fee-payment website was hit by a cyberattack, exposing data of account holders
geo_basis: country: the articles name France's DGAC but no city
summary: Toulouse7 and Tarbes7 report that France’s civil aviation authority (DGAC) told users by email its fee-payment website was hit by a cyberattack between 5 and 9 November 2026. GNT says exposed data includes contact details, IP addresses, account passwords it describes as protected, and partial card data with expiry date and the visual cryptogram. GNT says the DGAC states no complete payment method was stolen.
plain: France’s civil aviation authority told users its fee-payment website was attacked in early November. GNT reports contact details and partial card data were exposed; the DGAC says no complete payment method was stolen.
exec: Per GNT, a French civil aviation fee-payment site exposed user contact details and partial card data; the DGAC says no complete payment method was stolen.
action: GNT reports the DGAC renewed the key protecting passwords and asked users to change theirs.

sources.name: GNT (Génération-NT): Piratage de la DGAC : des données de pilotes et des cryptogrammes bancaires ont fuité

validation.note: Toulouse7 and Tarbes7 (one account of the DGAC email) and GNT (generation-nt.com) each state the cyberattack on the DGAC fee-payment site on 5-9 November; the DGAC's own notice was not read.

review.note: stronger than the source: GNT says passwords were protected, summary/plain/exec listed them as exposed; action advice now the DGAC's request to change passwords per GNT
